environment_provenance_gate.rule: cross-engine evidence requires complete ISA flags and one internally consistent full-CPU power policy

output_equivalence_gate.rule: every measured row needs a passing cross-engine equivalence verdict from the same input, Rust ELF and mermaid bundle (scripts/headtohead/equivalence.mjs)
output_equivalence_gate.method: linked_parse_semantics_via_svg_structural (rendered-text token containment + rendered-path edge topology cross-checked against input truth); not byte equality, not a rasterized perceptual diff

median_ci_gate_rule: effect CI excludes 1.0 when required; claim magnitude >= max(1.01, 1 + 2 * max(per-engine A/A CI radius)); every null median stays within 2% of 1.0
fm_bracket_gate_rule: Rust pre/post drift magnitude <= max(1.01, 1 + 2 * Rust A/A CI radius)

arm_asymmetry.rule: global phase CPU busy is provenance; numeric gate uses bracketed Rust A/A

semantic_work.rule: both engines must execute the same declared boundary over the same positive diagram count and byte-identical input; parse mode additionally requires every revision accepted

median_ci_gate.reason: A/A null median bias 4.090% exceeds 2% (arm-order asymmetry; the measurement environment was unfit, which says nothing about the effect being real)

output_equivalence.claim: engine-neutral structural equivalence: rendered-text multiset (all families) plus rendered-path edge topology cross-engine and against input-derived ground truth. Frankenmermaid endpoints are reconstructed geometrically; mermaid-js uses geometric endpoints when unambiguous and uniquely resolved per-path data-id endpoints otherwise. Not byte equality; not a pixel diff.
